name: @genoffice/ai-provider
description: Redrob-backed AI layer. Keeps the @genoffice/ai-provider TypeScript surface the ported editor apps import, but routes ALL chat/stream turns to the single Redrob Console engine (fixed base https://console.redrob.ai/api/backend/v1, model redrob-ai / redrob/auto). No provider selection, no BYOK, no configurable inference server URL, no third-party engine names in the routing path. On engine unavailability it surfaces the Redrob honest-failure notice; there is one engine, so a failure is a visible failure, not a silent swap.
